items.q: Interviewer: David Ritz with recording engineer Ken Kimery

ctx.x: Interviewer: David Ritz with recording engineer Ken Kimery Description: Transcript, 66 pp.

My name is David Ritz. It’s September 23rd, 2008. We’re in Las Vegas, Nevada, in the beautiful home of Jeannie and Jimmy Scott. Jimmy, do want to say your name? Is that what you want? Kimery: Name, birth date, . . .
